1195	/-- Effect of `depend(result, anchor)` (MM-03.3 §3, O5): the anchor joins the dependencies of
1196	the result place; existing dependencies are kept; propagation to containing values is computed
1197	by `depsOf`. -/
1198	def dependEff (s : S3) (q x : Nat) : S3 :=
1199	  { s with D := fun r => if r = q then s.D q ++ [x] else s.D r }

1201	/-- Preconditions of `depend` (MM-03.3 §3, O5), in order: result place usable (MM-03.3.1);
1202	1 valid anchor; 5 non-escape (MM-03.3.6); B3: exercisable `Modify` on the result; C1: the frame
1203	of the effective anchor is the frame of the result or an ancestor of it (`EffAnchorOK`). O5.2
1204	(real origin of the rights or storage) is not representable: the state does not relate a value
1205	to the origin of its content. O5.3 and O5.4 hold by construction. -/
1206	def DependPre (s : S3) (q x : Nat) : Prop :=
1207	  s.Usable q ∧ s.Active x ∧ NoEscape s x (s.pframe q) ∧ HasRight s .modify q ∧
1208	    EffAnchorOK s x (s.pframe q)

1217	/-! ## F4 `store` -/
1218	
1219	/-- Effect of `store a p` (F4), the write of a reference into a value: `a` is now held by the
1220	place `p`; `a` joins the anchors of `p`; the leaves of `p` become `Init`. -/
1221	def storeEff (s : S3) (a p : Nat) : S3 := match s.A[a]? with
1222	  | some y => { s with
1223	      A := s.A.set a { y with holder := .place p }
1224	      D := fun q => if q = p then s.D p ++ [a] else s.D q
1225	      I := fun l => if l ∈ footprint s.P p then .init else s.I l }
1226	  | none => s
1227	
1228	/-- Preconditions of `store a p` (F4), in order: `a` active, derived (`a.origin ≠ none`), held by
1229	the current frame; `p` usable; exercisable `Modify` on `p` (B2, `HasRight`); `a` covers no leaf
1230	of `p` nor of its owned storage, transitively (A5, `OwnedIn`); `AnchorOrder` for the added
1231	anchor (C1, `EffAnchorOK`): the frame of the effective anchor of `a` is the frame of `p` or one
1232	of its ancestors. No inverse operation exists (F4). -/
1233	def StorePre (s : S3) (a p : Nat) : Prop :=
1234	  OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.origin ≠ none ∧ y.holder = .frame s.top) False ∧
1235	  s.Usable p ∧ HasRight s .modify p ∧
1236	  (∀ l ∈ s.afp a, l ∉ footprint s.P p ∧
1237	    ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, OwnedIn s.P p q → l ∉ footprint s.P q) ∧
1238	  EffAnchorOK s a (s.pframe p)
1239	
1240	instance (s : S3) (a p : Nat) : Decidable (StorePre s a p) := by unfold StorePre; infer_instance
1241	
1242	/-- `store` as a relation (F4). -/
1243	def StoreStep (a p : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
1244	  Guarded (StorePre s a p) (storeEff s a p)

267	`Invalidates` is removed (B9). The obligations of each contract are named hypotheses of theorems, never

272	  Pinned : Nat → Prop
273	  ExternalDone : Nat → Prop

669	/-- Modes of the active descendants of `a` whose footprint covers leaf `p` (MM-03.3.5). -/
670	def descModes (s : S3) (a p : Nat) : List Mode :=
671	  (List.range s.A.length).filterMap fun j =>
672	    match s.A[j]? with
673	    | some y => if y.active = true ∧ p ∈ y.footprint ∧ a ∈ s.ancs j then some y.mode else none
674	    | none => none

676	/-- Cases 1 to 3 of MM-03.3.5 for an active authority covering the leaf, of mode `m`, whose
677	active covering descendants have modes `ds`. -/
678	def effOf (m : Mode) (ds : List Mode) : Option Mode :=
679	  if ds = [] then some m else if Mode.modify ∈ ds then none else some .observe
680	
681	/-- `effective(a, p)` (MM-03.3.5), computed per leaf, with no stored status: absent if `a` is
682	inactive or does not cover `p`, `effOf` otherwise. -/
683	def effective (s : S3) (a p : Nat) : Option Mode :=
684	  match s.A[a]? with
685	  | some x => if x.active = true ∧ p ∈ x.footprint then effOf x.mode (descModes s a p) else none
686	  | none => none

688	/-- Compatibility of effective modes for ordinary accesses (MM-03.3 §2, I1): only
689	`Observe`/`Observe` is compatible. -/
690	def Compat (m₁ m₂ : Mode) : Prop := m₁ = .observe ∧ m₂ = .observe

693	(MM-03.3 §3, O1.3). -/
694	def Allows (e : Option Mode) (m : Mode) : Prop := OptP e (fun e => m.le e) False

696	instance (e : Option Mode) (m : Mode) : Decidable (Allows e m) := by
697	  unfold Allows; infer_instance

699	/-- Footprint of authority `a`, empty if it does not exist. -/
700	def S3.afp (s : S3) (a : Nat) : List Nat := match s.A[a]? with
701	  | some x => x.footprint
702	  | none => []

704	/-- Appends an authority to `A`: its identity is `s.A.length`. -/
705	def S3.addAuth (s : S3) (y : Authority) : S3 := { s with A := s.A ++ [y] }

707	/-- Anchors of the value at `q`, inherited from its parts (MM-03.3.6: a containing value
708	inherits the dependencies of the contained values). -/
709	def depsOf (s : S3) (q : Nat) : List Nat :=
710	  ((List.range s.P.length).filter fun r => decide (partOf s.P r q)).flatMap s.D
711	
712	/-- Dependencies still valid for the values containing leaf `p` (MM-03.3 §5): every anchor of a
713	place of which `p` is a part is active. -/
714	def DepsValid (s : S3) (p : Nat) : Prop :=
715	  ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, partOf s.P p q → ∀ x ∈ s.D q, s.Active x

718	  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (∀ _ ∈ _, _))

720	/-- Non-escape restriction (MM-03.3.6) for anchor `x` and a destination of frame `fd`: if `x`
721	is a local anchor (no origin), its frame is `fd` or an ancestor of it, so `fd` does not outlive
722	it. The frame of an anchor is the frame of its holder (A4, A5). -/
723	def NoEscape (s : S3) (x : Nat) (fd : Option Nat) : Prop :=
724	  OptP (s.A[x]?) (fun y => y.origin = none →
725	    OptP (s.hframe y.holder) (fun g => OptP fd (fun f => ancestor s.F g f) True) True) True
726	
727	instance (s : S3) (x : Nat) (fd : Option Nat) : Decidable (NoEscape s x fd) := by
728	  unfold NoEscape; infer_instance
729	
730	/-- C1: the frame of the effective anchor of `x` exists and is `fd`, the frame of the dependent,
731	or one of its ancestors (MM-03.3.1, `ancestor`). The frame of an authority is the frame of its
732	holder (A4, A5). -/
733	def EffAnchorOK (s : S3) (x : Nat) (fd : Option Nat) : Prop :=
734	  OptP (s.A[s.effAnchor x]?) (fun z => OptP (s.hframe z.holder)
735	    (fun g => OptP fd (fun f => ancestor s.F g f) False) False) False
736	
737	instance (s : S3) (x : Nat) (fd : Option Nat) : Decidable (EffAnchorOK s x fd) := by
738	  unfold EffAnchorOK; infer_instance

740	/-- `mapI f i l` applies `f` to each element of `l` with its index, counted from `i`. -/
741	def mapI {α β : Type} (f : Nat → α → β) : Nat → List α → List β
742	  | _, [] => []
743	  | i, a :: l => f i a :: mapI f (i + 1) l
744	
745	theorem length_mapI {α β : Type} (f : Nat → α → β) :
746	    ∀ (i : Nat) (l : List α), (mapI f i l).length = l.length
747	  | _, [] => rfl
748	  | i, _ :: l => by simp [mapI, length_mapI f (i + 1) l]
749	
750	theorem getElem?_mapI {α β : Type} (f : Nat → α → β) :
751	    ∀ (i : Nat) (l : List α) (j : Nat), (mapI f i l)[j]? = (l[j]?).map (f (i + j))
752	  | _, [], _ => rfl
753	  | i, a :: l, 0 => by simp [mapI]
754	  | i, a :: l, j + 1 => by
755	    simp only [mapI, List.getElem?_cons_succ, getElem?_mapI f (i + 1) l j]
756	    congr 2; omega

758	/-! ## Exercisable authorities (A2, B2) -/
759	
760	/-- `s.ExercisableAt a m` (B2): authority `a` is exercisable at mode `m` when `m` does not exceed its
761	mode and it is held by the current frame, or held by a place `p` such that an authority
762	exercisable at mode `m` has an effective mode permitting `m` on the whole footprint of `p`. The
763	authority is active: the rights of a released authority cannot be exercised (MM-03.3 §3, O3).
764	Inductive, so no cycle justifies a right. -/
765	inductive S3.ExercisableAt (s : S3) : Nat → Mode → Prop where
766	  | base {a : Nat} {m : Mode} {y : Authority} : s.A[a]? = some y → y.active = true → m.le y.mode →
767	      y.holder = .frame s.top → S3.ExercisableAt s a m
768	  | held {a p b : Nat} {m : Mode} {y : Authority} : s.A[a]? = some y → y.active = true →
769	      m.le y.mode → y.holder = .place p → S3.ExercisableAt s b m →
770	      (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P p, Allows (effective s b l) m) → S3.ExercisableAt s a m
771	
772	/-- One step of `ExercisableAt · m`, read on a Boolean premise. -/
773	def exR (s : S3) (m : Mode) (E : Nat → Bool) (a : Nat) : Bool :=
774	  match s.A[a]? with
775	  | some y => y.active && decide (m.le y.mode) && match y.holder with
776	    | .frame f => decide (f = s.top)
777	    | .place p => (List.range s.A.length).any fun b =>
778	        decide (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P p, Allows (effective s b l) m) && E b
779	  | none => false
780	
781	theorem any_congr' {α : Type} {f g : α → Bool} : ∀ {l : List α}, (∀ b ∈ l, f b = g b) →
782	    l.any f = l.any g
783	  | [], _ => rfl
784	  | a :: l, h => by
785	    simp only [List.any_cons, h a (List.mem_cons_self ..),
786	      any_congr' fun b hb => h b (List.mem_cons_of_mem a hb)]
787	
788	theorem exR_rule (s : S3) (m : Mode) : KRule s.A.length (exR s m) where
789	  mono p q hpq a h := by
790	    unfold exR at h ⊢; split at h
791	    · simp only [Bool.and_eq_true] at h ⊢
792	      refine ⟨h.1, ?_⟩; split at h
793	      · simpa using h.2
794	      · simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, List.any_eq_true] at h ⊢
795	        obtain ⟨b, hb, hc, he⟩ := h.2
796	        exact ⟨b, hb, hc, hpq b he⟩
797	    · exact h
798	  bound p a h := by
799	    unfold exR at h; split at h
800	    · exact lt_of_getElem? ‹_›
801	    · cases h
802	  loc p q hpq a := by
803	    unfold exR; split
804	    · congr 1; split
805	      · rfl
806	      · exact any_congr' fun b hb => by rw [hpq b (List.mem_range.1 hb)]
807	    · rfl
808	
809	theorem exercisableAt_of_kiter (s : S3) (m : Mode) :
810	    ∀ k a, kiter (exR s m) k a = true → s.ExercisableAt a m
811	  | 0, _, h => by simp [kiter] at h
812	  | k + 1, a, h => by
813	    simp only [kiter, exR] at h
814	    split at h
815	    · rename_i y hy
816	      simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at h
817	      obtain ⟨⟨ha, hm⟩, h⟩ := h
818	      split at h
819	      · rename_i f hf; exact .base hy ha hm (by simp at h; rw [hf, h])
820	      · rename_i p hp
821	        simp only [List.any_eq_true, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at h
822	        obtain ⟨b, -, hc, hb⟩ := h
823	        exact .held hy ha hm hp (exercisableAt_of_kiter s m k b hb) hc
824	    · cases h
825	
826	theorem exR_base {s : S3} {m : Mode} {E : Nat → Bool} {a : Nat} {y : Authority}
827	    (hy : s.A[a]? = some y) (ha : y.active = true) (hm : m.le y.mode)
828	    (hf : y.holder = .frame s.top) : exR s m E a = true := by
829	  unfold exR; rw [hy]; simp [ha, hm, hf]
830	
831	theorem exR_held {s : S3} {m : Mode} {E : Nat → Bool} {a p b : Nat} {y : Authority}
832	    (hy : s.A[a]? = some y) (ha : y.active = true) (hm : m.le y.mode) (hp : y.holder = .place p)
833	    (hb : b < s.A.length) (hc : ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P p, Allows (effective s b l) m)
834	    (hE : E b = true) : exR s m E a = true := by
835	  simp only [exR, hy, ha, hp, Bool.true_and, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq,
836	    List.any_eq_true, List.mem_range]
837	  exact ⟨hm, b, hb, hc, hE⟩
838	
839	theorem exercisableAt_iff {s : S3} {a : Nat} {m : Mode} :
840	    s.ExercisableAt a m ↔ kiter (exR s m) (s.A.length + 1) a = true := by
841	  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, exercisableAt_of_kiter s m _ a⟩
842	  induction h with
843	  | base hy ha hm hf => exact exR_base hy ha hm hf
844	  | held hy ha hm hp hb hc ih =>
845	    rw [← kiter_fix (exR_rule s _)]
846	    have hb' := kiter_bound (exR_rule s _) _ _ ih
847	    exact exR_held hy ha hm hp hb' hc ih
848	
849	instance (s : S3) (a : Nat) (m : Mode) : Decidable (s.ExercisableAt a m) :=
850	  decidable_of_iff _ exercisableAt_iff.symm
851	
852	/-- The current frame has an authority exercisable at mode `m` whose effective mode permits `m` on
853	every leaf of `q` (B2: an operation requires the mode it requests). -/
854	def HasRight (s : S3) (m : Mode) (q : Nat) : Prop :=
855	  ∃ a ∈ List.range s.A.length, s.ExercisableAt a m ∧
856	    ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, Allows (effective s a l) m
857	
858	instance (s : S3) (m : Mode) (q : Nat) : Decidable (HasRight s m q) := by
859	  unfold HasRight; infer_instance

861	/-! ## Outcomes and guarded relations (MM-03.3 §3) -/
862	
863	/-- `Outcome3` (MM-03.3 §3): `ok` with the new state, or `reject`, refusal by the static
864	discipline, distinct from a defined failure of an abstraction and from `ub` of MM-02. -/
865	inductive Outcome3 (σ : Type) where
866	  | ok (s : σ)
867	  | reject
868	
869	/-- Common form of the transition rules of MM-03.3 §3–5: `ok` with the effect when the
870	precondition holds, `reject` otherwise. -/
871	inductive Guarded {σ : Type} (Pre : Prop) (eff : σ) : Outcome3 σ → Prop where
872	  | ok : Pre → Guarded Pre eff (.ok eff)
873	  | reject : ¬ Pre → Guarded Pre eff .reject
874	
875	theorem Guarded.det {σ : Type} {Pre : Prop} {eff : σ} {o₁ o₂ : Outcome3 σ}
876	    (h₁ : Guarded Pre eff o₁) (h₂ : Guarded Pre eff o₂) : o₁ = o₂ := by
877	  cases h₁ <;> cases h₂ <;> first | rfl | contradiction
878	
879	theorem Guarded.ok_iff {σ : Type} {Pre : Prop} {eff s' : σ} :
880	    Guarded Pre eff (.ok s') ↔ Pre ∧ s' = eff :=
881	  ⟨fun h => by cases h; exact ⟨‹_›, rfl⟩, fun ⟨h, e⟩ => e ▸ .ok h⟩
882	
883	theorem Guarded.reject_iff {σ : Type} {Pre : Prop} {eff : σ} :
884	    Guarded Pre eff .reject ↔ ¬ Pre :=
885	  ⟨fun h => by cases h; assumption, fun h => .reject h⟩
886	
887	/-! ## O1 `derive` (MM-03.3 §3) -/
888	
889	/-- Effect of `derive(source, place, mode)` (MM-03.3 §3, O1): a new active authority with
890	origin `src`, footprint `footprint place`, mode `m`, held by the current frame. -/
891	def deriveEff (s : S3) (src q : Nat) (m : Mode) : S3 :=
892	  s.addAuth ⟨m, some src, footprint s.P q, .frame s.top, true⟩
893	
894	/-- O1.4 (MM-03.3 §3): every existing authority stays compatible with the derived one in the
895	resulting state. Not a precondition of `derive`: it follows from O1.1 and O1.3 under I1
896	(`derive_compat_redundant`, A11). -/
897	def DeriveCompat (s : S3) (src q : Nat) (m : Mode) : Prop :=
898	  ∀ b ∈ List.range s.A.length, ∀ p ∈ footprint s.P q,
899	    OptP (effective (deriveEff s src q m) b p) (fun e => Compat e m) True
900	
901	/-- Preconditions of `derive` (MM-03.3 §3, O1), in order: 1 active origin, exercisable at the
902	requested mode (B2);
903	place still usable (MM-03.3.1); 2 requested footprint within the origin's; 3 mode permitted by
904	the effective authority of the origin on each leaf. O1.4 is removed (A11): it follows from the
905	others under I1 (`derive_compat_redundant`). O1.5 is not restated: `derive` deactivates
906	nothing. -/
907	def DerivePre (s : S3) (src q : Nat) (m : Mode) : Prop :=
908	  s.Active src ∧ s.ExercisableAt src m ∧ s.Usable q ∧
909	  (∀ p ∈ footprint s.P q, p ∈ s.afp src) ∧
910	  (∀ p ∈ footprint s.P q, Allows (effective s src p) m)
911	
912	instance (s : S3) (src q : Nat) (m : Mode) : Decidable (DerivePre s src q m) := by
913	  unfold DerivePre; infer_instance
914	
915	/-- `derive` as a relation (MM-03.3 §3, O1). -/
916	def DeriveStep (src q : Nat) (m : Mode) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
917	  Guarded (DerivePre s src q m) (deriveEff s src q m)
918	
919	/-! ## O2 `split` (MM-03.3 §3) -/
920	
921	/-- Effect of `split(source, regions)` (MM-03.3 §3, O2): one derived `Modify` authority per
922	region, held by the current frame; the origin remains a logical authority. -/
923	def splitEff (s : S3) (src : Nat) (rs : List (List Nat)) : S3 :=
924	  { s with A := s.A ++ rs.map fun r => ⟨.modify, some src, r, .frame s.top, true⟩ }
925	
926	/-- Exclusive right already distributed by `src` on leaf `p`: an active descendant of `src` in
927	mode `Modify` covering `p` (MM-03.3 §3, O2.4). -/
928	def DistribExcl (s : S3) (src j p : Nat) : Prop :=
929	  OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ src ∈ s.ancs j ∧ p ∈ y.footprint ∧ y.mode = .modify)
930	    False
931	
932	instance (s : S3) (src j p : Nat) : Decidable (DistribExcl s src j p) := by
933	  unfold DistribExcl; infer_instance
934	
935	/-- Preconditions of `split` (MM-03.3 §3, O2), in order: 1 the origin is an active authority,
936	exercisable at `Modify` (B2), with effective `Modify` on every leaf of the regions; 2 regions within the available footprint
937	(the origin's footprint where its effective authority is present); 3 regions pairwise disjoint,
938	structurally (no shared leaf) or by `DeclaredDisjoint` (MM-03.3.8); 4 no region covers an
939	exclusive right already distributed. O2.5 is not restated: `split` changes neither `D` nor
940	activity. -/
941	def SplitPre (k : K) (s : S3) (src : Nat) (rs : List (List Nat)) : Prop :=
942	  s.Active src ∧ s.ExercisableAt src .modify ∧ (∀ r ∈ rs, ∀ p ∈ r, effective s src p = some .modify) ∧
943	  (∀ r ∈ rs, ∀ p ∈ r, p ∈ s.afp src ∧ effective s src p ≠ none) ∧
944	  rs.Pairwise (fun r r' => (∀ l ∈ r, l ∉ r') ∨ k.DeclaredDisjoint r r') ∧
945	  (∀ r ∈ rs, ∀ p ∈ r, ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, ¬ DistribExcl s src j p)
946	
947	instance (k : K) [∀ r r', Decidable (k.DeclaredDisjoint r r')] (s : S3) (src : Nat)
948	    (rs : List (List Nat)) : Decidable (SplitPre k s src rs) := by
949	  unfold SplitPre; infer_instance
950	
951	/-- `split` as a relation (MM-03.3 §3, O2). -/
952	def SplitStep (k : K) (src : Nat) (rs : List (List Nat)) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
953	  Guarded (SplitPre k s src rs) (splitEff s src rs)
954	
955	/-! ## O3 `release` (MM-03.3 §3, A6) -/
956	
957	/-- Effect of `release(authority)` (MM-03.3 §3, O3; A6: end of a temporary access): the
958	authority becomes inactive. F4: an authority held by a place `q` leaves the anchors of `q` in the
959	same transition. -/
960	def releaseEff (s : S3) (a : Nat) : S3 := match s.A[a]? with
961	  | some x => { s with
962	      A := s.A.set a { x with active := false }
963	      D := fun q => if x.holder = .place q then (s.D q).filter (· != a) else s.D q }
964	  | none => s
965	
966	/-- Right of the current frame on a holder (C4): the holder is the current frame, or a place on
967	which the current frame has exercisable `Modify` (`HasRight`, B2). -/
968	def HolderRight (s : S3) : Holder → Prop
969	  | .frame f => f = s.top
970	  | .place p => HasRight s .modify p
971	
972	instance (s : S3) (h : Holder) : Decidable (HolderRight s h) := by
973	  cases h <;> unfold HolderRight <;> infer_instance
974	
975	/-- Preconditions of `release` (MM-03.3 §3, O3), in order: 1 active authority; 2 no active
976	descendant; 3 no usable place has `a` as anchor, except the place that holds `a`, whose anchor
977	`a` is removed by the release (F4); C4: the authority is derived, an authority
978	without origin is rejected, and its holder is the current frame or a place on which the current
979	frame has exercisable `Modify` (`HolderRight`). O3.4 (guarantees of associated abstractions) is
980	not represented in the kernel. -/
981	def ReleasePre (s : S3) (a : Nat) : Prop :=
982	  s.Active a ∧
983	  (∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, a ∈ s.ancs j → ¬ s.Active j) ∧
984	  (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.Usable q → a ∈ s.D q → (s.A[a]?).map (·.holder) = some (.place q)) ∧
985	  OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => y.origin ≠ none ∧ HolderRight s y.holder) False
986	
987	instance (s : S3) (a : Nat) : Decidable (ReleasePre s a) := by unfold ReleasePre; infer_instance
988	
989	/-- `release` as a relation (MM-03.3 §3, O3). -/
990	def ReleaseStep (a : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
991	  Guarded (ReleasePre s a) (releaseEff s a)
992	
993	/-! ## O4 `transfer` (MM-03.3 §3, A4, A5) -/
994	
995	/-- Holder within the value at `q` (A4): a place that is `q` or one of its parts. -/
996	def heldIn (P : List Place) (q : Nat) : Holder → Prop
997	  | .place r => partOf P r q
998	  | .frame _ => False
999

1195	/-- Effect of `depend(result, anchor)` (MM-03.3 §3, O5): the anchor joins the dependencies of
1196	the result place; existing dependencies are kept; propagation to containing values is computed
1197	by `depsOf`. -/
1198	def dependEff (s : S3) (q x : Nat) : S3 :=
1199	  { s with D := fun r => if r = q then s.D q ++ [x] else s.D r }
1200	
1201	/-- Preconditions of `depend` (MM-03.3 §3, O5), in order: result place usable (MM-03.3.1);
1202	1 valid anchor; 5 non-escape (MM-03.3.6); B3: exercisable `Modify` on the result; C1: the frame
1203	of the effective anchor is the frame of the result or an ancestor of it (`EffAnchorOK`). O5.2
1204	(real origin of the rights or storage) is not representable: the state does not relate a value
1205	to the origin of its content. O5.3 and O5.4 hold by construction. -/
1206	def DependPre (s : S3) (q x : Nat) : Prop :=
1207	  s.Usable q ∧ s.Active x ∧ NoEscape s x (s.pframe q) ∧ HasRight s .modify q ∧
1208	    EffAnchorOK s x (s.pframe q)
1209	
1210	instance (s : S3) (q x : Nat) : Decidable (DependPre s q x) := by
1211	  unfold DependPre; infer_instance
1212	
1213	/-- `depend` as a relation (MM-03.3 §3, O5). -/
1214	def DependStep (q x : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
1215	  Guarded (DependPre s q x) (dependEff s q x)
1216	
1217	/-! ## F4 `store` -/
1218	
1219	/-- Effect of `store a p` (F4), the write of a reference into a value: `a` is now held by the
1220	place `p`; `a` joins the anchors of `p`; the leaves of `p` become `Init`. -/
1221	def storeEff (s : S3) (a p : Nat) : S3 := match s.A[a]? with
1222	  | some y => { s with
1223	      A := s.A.set a { y with holder := .place p }
1224	      D := fun q => if q = p then s.D p ++ [a] else s.D q
1225	      I := fun l => if l ∈ footprint s.P p then .init else s.I l }
1226	  | none => s
1227	
1228	/-- Preconditions of `store a p` (F4), in order: `a` active, derived (`a.origin ≠ none`), held by
1229	the current frame; `p` usable; exercisable `Modify` on `p` (B2, `HasRight`); `a` covers no leaf
1230	of `p` nor of its owned storage, transitively (A5, `OwnedIn`); `AnchorOrder` for the added
1231	anchor (C1, `EffAnchorOK`): the frame of the effective anchor of `a` is the frame of `p` or one
1232	of its ancestors. No inverse operation exists (F4). -/
1233	def StorePre (s : S3) (a p : Nat) : Prop :=
1234	  OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.origin ≠ none ∧ y.holder = .frame s.top) False ∧
1235	  s.Usable p ∧ HasRight s .modify p ∧
1236	  (∀ l ∈ s.afp a, l ∉ footprint s.P p ∧
1237	    ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, OwnedIn s.P p q → l ∉ footprint s.P q) ∧
1238	  EffAnchorOK s a (s.pframe p)
1239	
1240	instance (s : S3) (a p : Nat) : Decidable (StorePre s a p) := by unfold StorePre; infer_instance
1241	
1242	/-- `store` as a relation (F4). -/
1243	def StoreStep (a p : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
1244	  Guarded (StorePre s a p) (storeEff s a p)
1245	
1246	/-! ## O6 `enterFrame` (MM-03.3 §4, A5) -/
1247	
1248	/-- Owner of the local of index `i` of `ls` (parent, owning local, kind) in the new frame `f`:

/-- A chain from `i` has at most `i` elements (A7: termination of the walk). -/

theorem chainF_congr {org org' : Nat → Option Nat} :
    ∀ k i, (∀ j ≤ i, org j = org' j) → chainF org k i = chainF org' k i
  | 0, _, _ => rfl
  | k + 1, i, h => by
    simp only [chainF]; rw [h i (Nat.le_refl i)]; split
    · split
      · rw [chainF_congr k _ fun j hj => h j (by omega)]
      · rfl
    · rfl

theorem chain_congr {org org' : Nat → Option Nat} {i : Nat} (h : ∀ j ≤ i, org j = org' j) :
    chain org i = chain org' i := chainF_congr i i h

/-- Two roots (elements without link) of one chain are equal. -/
theorem chainF_root {org : Nat → Option Nat} : ∀ k i r r', r ∈ chainF org k i → org r = none →

        · rw [chainF_none hr'] at h; simp at h

/-! ## Places (MM-03.3.2, A5) -/

/-- Holder of an authority (A4) or owner of a place (A5): a frame or a place. -/
inductive Holder where
  | frame (f : Nat)
  | place (p : Nat)
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- Logical place (MM-03.3.2: `Place { id, parent?, frame, kind }`). Its identity is its index
in `P`. The field `frame` of MM-03.3.2 is generalised by `owner` (A5): a place is owned by a
frame or by another place (owned storage). A part has the owner of its parent (`WF3`). `kind`
is not interpreted: MM-03.3.2 gives no values for it. -/
structure Place where
  parent : Option Nat
  owner : Holder
  kind : Nat
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- `parent` link of the place with index `i` (MM-03.3.2). -/
def parentOf (P : List Place) (i : Nat) : Option Nat := (P[i]?).bind (·.parent)

/-- `partOf P p q` (MM-03.3.2, logical composition): `p` is a place of `P` and `q` is `p` itself
or one of its ancestors along `parent`. -/
def partOf (P : List Place) (p q : Nat) : Prop :=
  p < P.length ∧ (p = q ∨ q ∈ chain (parentOf P) p)

instance (P : List Place) (p q : Nat) : Decidable (partOf P p q) :=
  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (_ ∧ _))

/-- Storage leaf (MM-03.3.2): a place without a strict part. -/
def isLeaf (P : List Place) (l : Nat) : Prop := ∀ r < P.length, parentOf P r ≠ some l

instance (P : List Place) (l : Nat) : Decidable (isLeaf P l) :=
  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (∀ _, _))

/-- `footprint P q` (MM-03.3.2): the leaves of `P` that are parts of `q`. -/
def footprint (P : List Place) (q : Nat) : List Nat :=
  (List.range P.length).filter fun l => decide (isLeaf P l ∧ partOf P l q)

/-- Two places overlap when their footprints share a leaf (MM-03.3.2). -/
def overlap (P : List Place) (p q : Nat) : Prop := ∃ l ∈ footprint P p, l ∈ footprint P q

instance (P : List Place) (p q : Nat) : Decidable (overlap P p q) :=
  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (∃ _ ∈ _, _))

/-- Structural disjointness (MM-03.3.2): neither path is a part of the other. -/
def structurallyDisjoint (P : List Place) (p q : Nat) : Prop := ¬ partOf P p q ∧ ¬ partOf P q p

instance (P : List Place) (p q : Nat) : Decidable (structurallyDisjoint P p q) :=
  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (_ ∧ _))

theorem mem_footprint {P : List Place} {q l : Nat} :
    l ∈ footprint P q ↔ l < P.length ∧ isLeaf P l ∧ partOf P l q := by
  simp [footprint, List.mem_filter, List.mem_range]

theorem footprint_congr {P P' : List Place} (hlen : P'.length = P.length)
    (hpar : parentOf P' = parentOf P) (q : Nat) : footprint P' q = footprint P q := by
  unfold footprint; rw [hlen]; congr 1; funext l
  exact decide_eq_decide.2 (by simp only [isLeaf, partOf, hpar, hlen])

/-! ## Least fixed points on a bounded universe

`Usable` (A5) and `ExercisableAt` (B2) are inductive predicates. Each is the least fixed point of
a monotone rule over identities below a bound `n`; its Kleene iteration is stable after `n + 1`
steps, which makes it decidable. -/

/-- `k`-th Kleene iterate of a rule `R` on Boolean predicates over `Nat`. -/
def kiter (R : (Nat → Bool) → Nat → Bool) : Nat → Nat → Bool
  | 0, _ => false
  | k + 1, a => R (kiter R k) a

/-- A monotone rule whose conclusions lie below `n` and which reads its premise only below
`n`. -/
structure KRule (n : Nat) (R : (Nat → Bool) → Nat → Bool) : Prop where
  mono : ∀ p q : Nat → Bool, (∀ a, p a = true → q a = true) → ∀ a, R p a = true → R q a = true
  bound : ∀ p a, R p a = true → a < n
  loc : ∀ p q : Nat → Bool, (∀ a, a < n → p a = q a) → ∀ a, R p a = R q a

theorem kiter_mono {n : Nat} {R : (Nat → Bool) → Nat → Bool} (h : KRule n R) :
    ∀ k a, kiter R k a = true → kiter R (k + 1) a = true
  | 0, _, hk => by simp [kiter] at hk
  | k + 1, a, hk => h.mono _ _ (kiter_mono h k) a hk

theorem kiter_bound {n : Nat} {R : (Nat → Bool) → Nat → Bool} (h : KRule n R) :
    ∀ k a, kiter R k a = true → a < n
  | 0, _, hk => by simp [kiter] at hk
  | _ + 1, a, hk => h.bound _ a hk

theorem countP_le_of {l : List Nat} {p q : Nat → Bool} (hpq : ∀ a ∈ l, p a = true → q a = true) :
    l.countP p ≤ l.countP q := by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp
  | cons a l ih =>
    simp only [List.countP_cons]
    have := ih fun b hb => hpq b (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hb)
    cases hp : p a <;> cases hq : q a <;> simp_all <;> omega

theorem countP_lt_of {l : List Nat} {p q : Nat → Bool} (hpq : ∀ a ∈ l, p a = true → q a = true)
    {x : Nat} (hx : x ∈ l) (hqx : q x = true) (hpx : p x = false) : l.countP p < l.countP q := by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp at hx
  | cons a l ih =>
    simp only [List.countP_cons]
    have hle := countP_le_of (l := l) fun b hb => hpq b (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hb)
    rcases List.mem_cons.1 hx with rfl | hx
    · simp [hqx, hpx]; omega
    · have := ih (fun b hb => hpq b (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hb)) hx
      cases hp : p a <;> cases hq : q a <;> simp_all <;> omega

theorem all_false_exists {α : Type} {p : α → Bool} : ∀ {l : List α}, l.all p = false →
    ∃ a ∈ l, p a = false
  | [], h => by simp at h
  | a :: l, h => by
    simp only [List.all_cons, Bool.and_eq_false_iff] at h
    rcases h with h | h
    · exact ⟨a, List.mem_cons_self .., h⟩
    · obtain ⟨b, hb, hb'⟩ := all_false_exists h; exact ⟨b, List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hb, hb'⟩

/-- Stability of the iteration at step `k`, below `n`. -/
def kstab (R : (Nat → Bool) → Nat → Bool) (n k : Nat) : Bool :=
  (List.range n).all fun a => kiter R (k + 1) a == kiter R k a

theorem kstab_succ {n : Nat} {R : (Nat → Bool) → Nat → Bool} (h : KRule n R) {k : Nat}
    (hs : kstab R n k = true) : kstab R n (k + 1) = true := by
  simp only [kstab, List.all_eq_true, List.mem_range, beq_iff_eq] at hs ⊢
  intro a ha
  show R (kiter R (k + 1)) a = R (kiter R k) a
  exact h.loc _ _ (fun b hb => hs b hb) a

theorem kstab_le {n : Nat} {R : (Nat → Bool) → Nat → Bool} (h : KRule n R) {k : Nat}
    (hs : kstab R n k = true) : ∀ j, k ≤ j → kstab R n j = true
  | j, hj => by
    induction j with
    | zero => obtain rfl : k = 0 := by omega
              exact hs
    | succ j ih =>
      rcases Nat.lt_or_ge k (j + 1) with hlt | hge
      · exact kstab_succ h (ih (by omega))
      · obtain rfl : k = j + 1 := by omega
        exact hs

theorem kstab_exists {n : Nat} {R : (Nat → Bool) → Nat → Bool} (h : KRule n R) :
    ∀ k, (∃ j, j < k ∧ kstab R n j = true) ∨ k ≤ (List.range n).countP (kiter R k)
  | 0 => .inr (Nat.zero_le _)
  | k + 1 => by
    rcases kstab_exists h k with hj | hc
    · obtain ⟨j, hj, hs⟩ := hj; exact .inl ⟨j, by omega, hs⟩
    · cases hs : kstab R n k
      · obtain ⟨a, ha, hne⟩ := all_false_exists hs
        simp only [List.mem_range, beq_eq_false_iff_ne] at ha hne
        have hk : kiter R k a = false := by
          cases e : kiter R k a
          · rfl
          · exact absurd (kiter_mono h k a e) (by rw [e] at hne; simpa using hne)
        have hk1 : kiter R (k + 1) a = true := by
          cases e : kiter R (k + 1) a
          · rw [e, hk] at hne; exact absurd rfl hne
          · rfl
        have := countP_lt_of (l := List.range n) (fun b _ hb => kiter_mono h k b hb)
          (List.mem_range.2 ha) hk1 hk
        exact .inr (by omega)
      · exact .inl ⟨k, by omega, hs⟩

/-- The iteration is stable from step `n + 1` on. -/
theorem kiter_fix {n : Nat} {R : (Nat → Bool) → Nat → Bool} (h : KRule n R) (a : Nat) :
    kiter R (n + 2) a = kiter R (n + 1) a := by
  rcases kstab_exists h (n + 1) with ⟨j, hj, hs⟩ | hc
  · have hs' := kstab_le h hs (n + 1) (by omega)
    by_cases ha : a < n
    · simp only [kstab, List.all_eq_true, List.mem_range, beq_iff_eq] at hs'
      exact hs' a ha
    · cases e : kiter R (n + 2) a
      · cases e' : kiter R (n + 1) a
        · rfl
        · exact absurd (kiter_bound h _ a e') ha
      · exact absurd (kiter_bound h _ a e) ha
  · have := List.countP_le_length (p := kiter R (n + 1)) (l := List.range n)
    simp at this; omega

5957	/-- The place of the arena value: the holder of `internal` (F1, replacing the owner of the storage
5958	of A10 and D3). -/
5959	def arenaValue (s : S3) (ar : Arena) : Option Nat :=
5960	  match s.A[ar.internal]? with
5961	  | some y =>
5962	    match y.holder with
5963	    | .place v => some v
5964	    | .frame _ => none
5965	  | none => none

5967	/-- Metadata leaves of the arena: the footprint of the arena value (A10). -/
5968	def metaLeaves (s : S3) (ar : Arena) : List Nat :=
5969	  match arenaValue s ar with
5970	  | some v => footprint s.P v
5971	  | none => []

5973	/-- Arena invariant (MM-03.3 §6; A10; D3; F1; F2). Clauses of §6: issued regions within the
5974	administered storage (the footprint of `internal`); two simultaneously valid issued regions
5975	disjoint; available regions disjoint from the still distributed ones; added: available regions
5976	within the storage. Clause of A10: each emission is a `Modify` authority derived from `internal`
5977	on its region. F2: the storage is a place of `P`, owned by anything (a local, a static, an
5978	allocated root, a block): the ownership clause of A10 is removed. F1: `internal` is a `Modify`
5979	authority held by a place, the arena value, and covers exactly the footprint of the storage. -/
5980	def ArenaInv (s : S3) (ar : Arena) : Prop :=
5981	  (∀ l ∈ ar.available, l ∈ s.afp ar.internal) ∧
5982	  (∀ e ∈ ar.issued, ∀ l ∈ e.1, l ∈ s.afp ar.internal) ∧
5983	  ar.issued.Pairwise (fun e e' => s.Active e.2 → s.Active e'.2 → ∀ l ∈ e.1, l ∉ e'.1) ∧
5984	  (∀ e ∈ ar.issued, s.Active e.2 → ∀ l ∈ e.1, l ∉ ar.available) ∧
5985	  (∀ e ∈ ar.issued, ∃ y, s.A[e.2]? = some y ∧ y.origin = some ar.internal ∧
5986	    y.footprint = e.1 ∧ y.mode = .modify) ∧
5987	  ar.storage < s.P.length ∧
5988	  (∃ (y : Authority) (v : Nat), s.A[ar.internal]? = some y ∧ y.mode = .modify ∧
5989	    y.holder = .place v) ∧
5990	  (∀ l, l ∈ s.afp ar.internal ↔ l ∈ footprint s.P ar.storage)

6050	/-- `arena.issue` as a relation (MM-03.3 §6; A10): `reject` when a static precondition fails;
6051	`fail`, with the state unchanged, when the region is unavailable; `reject` when the region is
6052	available but `internal` lacks the right to distribute it; `ok` otherwise. -/
6053	inductive IssueStep (k : K) (ar : Arena) (via : Nat) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) (s : S3) :
6054	    IOutcome → Prop where
6055	  | ok : IssueStatic k s ar via region dst → Avail ar region → IssueRight s ar region →
6056	      IssueStep k ar via region dst s
6057	        (.ok (issueEff s ar region dst).1 (issueEff s ar region dst).2)
6058	  | fail : IssueStatic k s ar via region dst → ¬ Avail ar region →
6059	      IssueStep k ar via region dst s (.fail s ar)
6060	  | reject : ¬ IssueStatic k s ar via region dst → IssueStep k ar via region dst s .reject
6061	  | noRight : IssueStatic k s ar via region dst → Avail ar region → ¬ IssueRight s ar region →
6062	      IssueStep k ar via region dst s .reject

6064	/-- Determinism of `issue` (MM-03.3 §6; A10). -/
6065	theorem issue_det {k : K} {ar : Arena} {via dst : Nat} {region : List Nat} {s : S3}
6066	    {o₁ o₂ : IOutcome} (h₁ : IssueStep k ar via region dst s o₁)

content.content:
task_mm03_p3.md:11:B2. `ExercisableAt s a m` : l'autorité `a` est exerçable au mode `m` ssi `m ≤ a.mode` et (`a` détenue par le cadre courant, ou détenue par un emplacement `p` tel qu'une autorité exerçable au mode `m` ait un mode effectif ≥ `m` sur toute l'empreinte de `p`). Toutes les opérations exigent le mode qu'elles demandent, pas le mode propre de l'autorité.
task_mm03_p3.md:12:B3. Droits : `release` exige une autorité détenue par le cadre courant ou exerçable par lui ; `depend` exige `Modify` exerçable sur le résultat ; `unpin` exige le même droit que `pin` (`Modify`).
task_mm03_p3.md:15:  - `provider` est l'emplacement de la valeur allocateur, distinct de `owner` en général. Exige un droit de mise à jour de ses métadonnées : `Modify` exerçable, ou `writeShared` sur feuilles `SharedMutable`, comme `issue`.
task_mm03_p3.md:16:  - `owner` reçoit la possession ; exige `Modify` exerçable sur `owner`.
task_mm03_p3.md:30:3. B2, B3 : `ExercisableAt`, droits de `release`, `depend`, `unpin` ; `exercise_requires_hold` réénoncé par mode. Témoin : lecture du stockage possédé d'une valeur partagée en `Observe` → `ok`.
task_mm03_p5.md:15:  - `newArena storage : ok | reject` enregistre une arène. Préconditions : `Modify` exerçable sur `storage` ; `storage` utilisable ; aucune arène vivante n'a déjà ce stockage. `internal` est l'autorité `Modify` détenue par le propriétaire de `storage` et couvrant exactement son empreinte : sa racine si `storage` est une racine allouée, l'autorité de bloc si `storage` est un bloc émis par une autre arène (arène imbriquée).
task_mm03_p4.md:13:C4. `release` : `reject` sur une autorité sans origine. Une autorité dérivée est libérable si elle est détenue par le cadre courant, ou par un emplacement `p` sur lequel le cadre courant a `Modify` exerçable.
task_mm03_p4.md:15:C6. `alloc provider owner shape : ok | fail | reject`, `shape` au même encodage que les locaux de `enterFrame` (forêt indexée, parents d'indice inférieur) ; la forme est abstraite, elle ne fixe ni alignement ni disposition, réservés au jalon 2. Exige des feuilles `Init` sur le fournisseur. L'effet met les métadonnées du fournisseur à `Init`. `issue` aligné : `MetaRight` accepte aussi `Modify` exerçable sur la valeur arène.
task_mm03_p2.md:11:A2. `Exercisable` défini inductivement et bien fondé : cas de base, autorité active détenue par le cadre courant ; cas inductif, autorité détenue par un emplacement `p` dont le cadre courant possède déjà une autorité exerçable de mode effectif ≥ sur toute l'empreinte de `p`. Aucun cycle ne justifie un droit. Exigé par `derive` (source), `split`, `read3`, `write3`, `writeShared`, `transfer` (`Modify` sur source et destination), `issue` (destination), `free`, `endUse`, `pin`.
task_mm03_p2.md:17:  - `endUse p` : événement **final** de la valeur en `p`. Préconditions : `Modify` exerçable sur `p` ; aucune autorité active dérivée sur l'empreinte de `p` détenue ailleurs ; aucun emplacement utilisable ancré sur une autorité détenue par `p` ou sur sa racine ; aucune feuille épinglée sans `K.ExternalDone`. Effet : feuilles `Uninit`, autorités encore détenues par `p` libérées, dépendances de `p` supprimées, emplacements possédés logiquement morts. N'exécute rien, ne libère aucun stockage, n'émet aucun événement de désallocation ; une allocation possédée non libérée est une fuite, à signaler, pas une erreur du modèle. Modélisé comme opération explicite ; son placement est hors modèle, et dans les cas d'épreuve un `free` programmé compte comme utilisation : `endUse` ne le précède jamais ;
task_mm03_p2.md:18:  - `free p auth` : libération explicite d'un emplacement possédé. Exige `K.Deallocable p` (unité libérable selon le contrat de l'allocateur ; un bloc d'arène ne l'est pas), une autorité de désallocation `auth` compatible (`K.FreeCompat p auth`, raccordée à `Compatible` de MM-02 au jalon 2), `Modify` exerçable, aucune autorité active dérivée sur son empreinte détenue ailleurs, aucun emplacement utilisable ancré dessus, aucune feuille épinglée. Effet : `p` mort ;

commit 33d57afb3cfb8829c83c3bfb4f0316bf9cd512a1
Author: Guy Senpai <guy.senpai@gmail.com>
Date:   Fri Oct 30 12:02:27 2026 +0100

    MM03 pass 6, step 5: cases and progress (F7)
    
    New cases: nested arena with a distinct child value; arena on a local
    buffer through a stored authority, transfer to the caller rejected; arena
    on an owned allocation returned; stored view, transfer to the caller
    rejected, to a local accepted; store of a root rejected; store then endUse

findings.title: F7 (a): the arbitrated rules accept the second store, which the brief expected to be rejected; the only clause that could reject it is HasRight, and it holds through the first stored authority
findings.evidence: Brief F7 (a) says the second store is expected to be rejected ("Attendu : le second store est rejeté. Rapporter la clause en cause."). I checked each StorePre clause for `store 8 6` in fa7 by `decide` in /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-guygouri-Devlab-ernlang-ern/c986905c-e900-4fd9-bebc-4a3ce7ebb180/scratchpad/rev12/f7/f7a.lean. All of them hold: 8 is active, derived and held by frame 1; 6 is usable; HasRight fa7 .modify 6 holds; 8 covers [5], which is disjoint from footprint 6 = [6], and 6 has no owned storage; EffAnchorOK holds, because the effective anchor is root 4, held by place 0, frame 1. The clause the arbiter most likely expected to fail is "Modify exercisable on p" (HasRight). Block 6 has lost its effective Modify on B (effective fa7 6 6 = none). Lean shows that 7 is the only witness: `∀ a ∈ range, ExercisableAt a .modify ∧ Allows… on footprint 6 → a = 7`. 7 is held by place 5 (A). By B2 (`ExercisableAt.held`) it is exercisable through 8, which is held by the frame, with fa7.ExercisableAt 8 .modify and effective fa7 8 5 = some .modify. After the store, ¬HasRight fa8 .modify 5, ¬HasRight fa8 .modify 6 and ¬HasRight fa8 .observe 5/6, so nothing can reach 7 or 8. The verdict does not depend on decision (8): with the other reading, which stores into the node values (locals 2 and 3), `StoreStep 7 2 fa5 ok`, `DeriveStep 5 5 .modify` and `StoreStep 8 3 ok` all hold, and both 7 and 8 stay exercisable (f7a.lean, ga6/ga7). The formalization follows F4 + B2. The F7 expectation contradicts them.
findings.suggested_fix: Report to the arbiter. The clause in cause is F4's "Modify exerçable sur p" (B2 counts authorities held by places). Rejecting the second store needs a semantic change, such as excluding place-held authorities from the store right or adding a cycle check. That is not a modeling choice.

findings.title: progress_cycle_whole_nodes docstring presents rejections as effects of the cycle, but two of them already occur before it; its permanence is unproven
findings.evidence: The docstring says: "After it, 7 and 8 are each exercisable only through the other: neither is exercisable, neither can be released, the node values cannot end, the arena cannot be reset. The exit of frame 1 releases both." The theorem proves only one-step rejections in fa8. Two of them do not depend on the cycle (f7a.lean): `ResetAtStep K0 0 0 fa4 .reject` (the blocks 5 and 6 are active before any store) and `EndUseStep K0 2 fa7 .reject` (8 is active, derived from block 5, held by the frame), although `ReleaseStep 8 fa7 ok`. Saying that only the exit releases 7 and 8 claims that no longer sequence in frame 1 frees them. No theorem shows this, and the brief's rule says "Aucune conclusion d'impossibilité sans preuve : une séquence non trouvée est un résultat ouvert".
findings.suggested_fix: Reword the docstring as one-step facts in fa8: 7 and 8 are not exercisable; release of 7 or 8, endUse of 2 or 3 and reset are rejected. Note that the endUse and reset rejections already hold before the cycle, and state that whether frame 1 can free 7 or 8 before exiting is open, unless it is proven.

findings.title: progress_cycle_whole_nodes docstring: 'each state ... with a non-empty list of arenas' is false for fa0 and fa1
findings.evidence: The docstring says: "Each state is reached from `S3.init []`, with a non-empty list of arenas." Lean: `fa0.arenas = [] ∧ fa1.arenas = []` holds by `decide` (/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-guygouri-Devlab-ernlang-ern/c986905c-e900-4fd9-bebc-4a3ce7ebb180/scratchpad/rev12/f7/f7c.lean). #eval of the arena counts for fa0, fa1 and fa2 gives (0, 0, 1). The theorem states `fa8.arenas ≠ []` only. fa2 through fa8 and exitEff fa8 do have arenas.
findings.suggested_fix: Limit the claim to the states from fa2 on (newArena onward), or to the cycle states.

findings.title: F7 (b) teardown verdict depends on decision (8), where 'node' means the region place for the stores and the block-holding local for endUse
findings.evidence: The brief says: "démontage par release des deux autorités stockées, endUse des nœuds, puis reset de l'arène accepté". The code takes the node as region place 5 (fields 6, 7) and 8 (fields 9, 10) for the stores and views, but ends the locals 2 and 3 that hold the blocks (docstring: "`endUse` of the node values 2 and 3, which releases the blocks"). If endUse is applied to the same 'node' as the stores, both calls are rejected (f7b.lean): `EndUseStep K0 5 fb9 .reject` and `EndUseStep K0 8 fb9 .reject`. The reason is `¬ EndUseAccessOK fb9 5 5`: block 5, held by place 2, covers the ending leaves 6 and 7 and stays live (A2: "aucune autorité active dérivée sur l'empreinte de p détenue ailleurs"), and `HasRight fb9 .modify 5` holds. The reset then stays rejected (`ResetAtStep K0 0 0 fb9 .reject`). The implementer's reading is the only one under which the expected 'reset accepted' can be reached. It is declared in the docstring and in decision (8), so it is not silent. The verdict of (a) is unaffected (see the first finding).
findings.suggested_fix: Have the arbiter confirm in report section (p) that 'endUse des nœuds' means the values holding the blocks, not the node places that the stores write into.
